definitions.explanation: a prepared area of soil where seeds are sown and seedlings are raised before being transplanted to their final growing location

examples.japanese: {苗床|なえどこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{植|う}え{替|か}える→植え替える：17856_uekaeru⟧。
examples.english: Transplant the seedlings raised in the nursery bed to the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧になったら{苗床|なえどこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧、⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まく⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: When spring comes, I plan to prepare the seedbed and sow tomato seeds.

notes:
{苗床|なえどこ} is a seedbed — a prepared area where seeds are germinated and seedlings grown before transplanting to their final location. Composed of ⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧ (seedling) + {床|どこ} (bed, floor).

USAGE:
Can refer to a dedicated garden bed, a greenhouse nursery tray, or any controlled environment for starting seeds. Also used figuratively: 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苗床|なえどこ} (a breeding ground/nursery for ~).
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苗床|なえどこ}: a breeding ground for crime
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苗床|なえどこ}: a nursery for talent
